Add 50 g to 100 g cumulative
Add 100 g to 200 g cumulative

action: Add 250 g water before adding coffee
Add 15 g coffee and mix gently

Place the Clever on the server to release

action: Remove the brewer when drawdown completes
Rinse the paper, close the valve, and add 15 g coffee
Add 250 g water and stir for about 15 seconds

action: Steep
Place on server and drain

action: Insert and rinse the V60 02 paper, then close the Switch

completion: Rinse drained before closure and no new dripping occurs

action: Add 20 g coffee and 240 g water

action: Steep
Move the lever to open the valve

action: Observe drawdown and remove the brewer
Close the Switch and bloom with 50 g
Open the valve and pour 100 g to 150 g cumulative

action: Close the valve and pour 90 g to 240 g cumulative

action: Open the valve for final release
Complete drawdown
Open the Switch valve and rinse the V60 02 paper
Bloom all grounds
Pour slowly to 250 g
Complete drawdown

action: Mix before heating until no dry clumps remain
Heat slowly while watching continuously

action: Remove from heat at the first controlled foam rise
equipmentState: Pot lifted safely before rolling boil/overflow

warning: Do not wait for violent boiling; boil-over can occur in seconds.

action: Pour gently to retain foam
completion: Foam and liquid are distributed without spilling

action: Let grounds settle before drinking
completion: Surface cools and dense grounds collect at bottom

action: Combine 130 g cold water, 12 g very fine coffee and optional sugar
Mix before heating
Heat slowly to the first foam rise
warning: Remove before rolling boil or overflow.

action: Remove briefly until the foam subsides
warning: Do not set hot metal on a vulnerable surface.

action: Return to low heat for one final bounded rise
warning: Stop at the second rise; repeated boiling increases spill and flavour risk.

action: Remove, divide foam and liquid, and let grounds settle
completion: Servings poured without overflow and grounds settle

action: Prepare the correct basket with 60 g level coffee

action: Fill the reservoir with 1,000 g cold water and position the carafe

action: Start and allow the machine-controlled cycle to run

action: Let the phin finish near five minutes
